title: Filipino Pork Menudo
description: A classic Filipino dish made with pork, liver, and vegetables in a rich tomato-based sauce, served in a bento box, earthy and fluffy, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe is egg-free-friendly and features piccalilli, using rest-meat for a hearty and satisfying meal
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pork shoulder and pork liver, and cook until browned.
Add the tomato sauce, piccalilli, potato, salt, black pepper, and fish sauce, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the menudo hot in a bento box.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
